blurb: Kris Finn is a native Iowan who has lived in Central Florida for 30 years. She received her degree in studio art from the University of Iowa and has taught multiple student levels since 1998. Her personal work includes a wide variety of media with a focus on acrylic paint, fibers, watercolor, jewelry, metals, mosaic and ink.
